'''''Shadow''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] used by [[Zaarin coup forces]] and belonging belonging to Rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin]]. This frigate, along with [[Serpent (Strike-class)|''Serpent'']], a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]], and [[Grappler (Immobilizer 418 cruiser)|''Grappler'']], an [[Immobilizer 418 Interdictor-class Heavy Cruiser|Immobilizer 418 cruiser]], attempted to trap [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] in his [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory I''-class Star Destroyer]], ''[[Sceltor]]'', in order to steal the [[Mag-pulse warhead/Legends|Mag Pulse]] Warhead. The attack was unsuccessful and the ''Shadow'' was destroyed.
